About these 6 rides

They ride on 4 days of the week; Tuesday and Saturday have the most, 2 each. The earliest start is Saturday Morning Nomad Leisurely Ride at 8:00 am; the latest is Monday Nights at Arcadia Trails at 6:45 pm. After work, 4 roll on a weekday evening. The group waits for everyone on 5 of them (no-drop). By bike: 5 social, 4 road and 1 mountain bike. Each one was checked at its source between Sep 15 and Oct 1, 2026.
